summary: SMFG filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its share repurchase program authorized May 13, 2026. It repurchased 28,018,600 shares for JPY 179,999,535,300 (~JPY 6,424/share) via market purchases, reaching the JPY 180 billion cap. It will cancel 28,018,600 shares (0.7% of issued) on August 20, 2026, retiring all repurchased shares. This capital return reduces share count and boosts per-share metrics, consistent with Japanese corporate governance reforms. Watch for further buyback authorizations and EPS accretion effects.
